color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
A genome proposed by Bedrock
birth · mutation · merge

div.style: color: rgb(59, 38, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
pydantic, extra='forbid'
action must be one of 20 · target required · 1–12 steps
an inverse must itself be a known action

div.style: color: rgb(59, 38, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Rejected — unknown action, missing target, invented field,
prose instead of JSON. Logged with its payload.
A malformed genome is stillborn: never inserted, never executed.

div.style: color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 26, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Credentials
Secrets Manager, read at cold start, cached per environment
nothing in code, nothing in git history
.env is gitignored and stays that way

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Rotation is two steps, not one. get_secret is @functools.cache'd and
the pool is a module global, so a warm environment serves the old value
forever. Writing a new version has no effect until every function is cycled.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 26, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Per-function IAM — four managed policies, attached only where used
DbRead: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on three named secret ARNs
BedrockInvoke: InvokeModel on the two model ARNs
S3Artifacts: Get/Put on the bucket, not on S3
CloudWatchMetrics: PutMetricData, which has no resource-level scope

div.style: color: rgb(11, 26, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Deploy identity — a scoped IAM user, not root keys
CloudFormation limited to stack/nexus/*, the artifact bucket pinned
so no second managed stack is needed

div.style: color: rgb(11, 26, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Webhook — Bearer shared secret on the changefeed sink
the receiver rejects anything else before parsing a byte

div.style: color: rgb(11, 26, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
ccloud — a service account scoped CLUSTER_DEVELOPER
read and connect, no cluster mutation, read-only again in the argv

div.style: color: rgb(11, 26, 58) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p: Database — a least-privilege app user, never admin

svg.text: NEXUS — trust boundaries and least privilege
